newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Road Builder shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Road Builder shares suspended.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Road Builder (M) Holdings Bhd shares were suspended on Friday afternoon, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said.
An official for Road Builder said the suspension was requested by the company pending an announcement. She said she could not disclose the nature of the announcement, nor the date it would be made.
Road Builder shares were suspended after the morning trading session, when they dropped 40 cents to 13.00 ringgit.
Road Builder is involved in the construction of privatised toll roads, and commercial and residential property development.
